ground_truth_draft.expected_behavior: Deserializing a RawValue from a byte slice containing invalid UTF-8 inside a JSON string must now return an InvalidUnicodeCodePoint error instead of panicking via str::from_utf8(...).unwrap() in end_raw_buffering.
ground_truth_draft.rationale_from_pr_metadata: PR title 'Fix panic deserializing RawValue from invalid utf-8 bytes' and body 'Fixes #755' explicitly identify the defect as a panic on invalid UTF-8 in RawValue. The diff replaces the .unwrap() in SliceRead::end_raw_buffering with a match that returns ErrorCode::InvalidUnicodeCodePoint, and a new regression test test_raw_invalid_utf8 asserts the error message for both Value and Box<RawValue> deserialization of bytes \xCE\xF8.

ai_baseline.notes: Rank1 nails error_propagation (panic→Err), rank2 nails assumption_boundary on the UTF-8 slice precondition. Rank3 test_gap (IoRead path uncovered) is supporting but plausible.

fact_only.notes: Only surfaces quality prod_change_with_tests (supporting). No direct mechanism for the panic→Err change; reviewer would not catch the UTF-8 assumption from this alone.

semantic_filtered.notes: Semantic panic_to_error_propagation_changed (direct, high) precisely identifies the error_propagation mechanism. Misses the assumption_boundary framing on the UTF-8 slice precondition.
